universal_lens: The universal lens unifies physical and cyber domains via a Hamiltonian operator acting on a hybrid state space. By treating system organization as a constrained optimization over integrated modules, the lens maps multiphysics dynamics to a single symplectic flow, ensuring seamless data processing and control across analog-digital boundaries. Cyber-physical systems integrate physical processes with computational models through data-driven control and secure information exchange.
gsi_mapping: GSI employs Bayesian inference over the latent states of seamlessly integrated components. Conformal prediction intervals bound the uncertainty of data management and control outputs, guaranteeing overall specifications by dynamically updating posterior distributions based on real-time telemetry from mixed-signal ASICs and microcontrollers. Bayesian inference frameworks model sensor data uncertainty and system dynamics within CPS for probabilistic decision-making under risk.
gse_mapping: GSE models situational reasoning as transitions within a high-dimensional cyber-physical state manifold. The engine evaluates concurrent design choices by propagating probability densities through the underlying engineering solutions, predicting optimal system organization and functionality under dynamic environmental perturbations and strict cybersecurity constraints. Situationally-aware state transitions in CPS are governed by multi-agent coordination protocols that process real-time telemetry and enforce functional constraints.
